title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E (Windows, launch-profiles) shard - Deno AppHost debug session times out, then teardown fails with EBUSY, unrelated to PR changes
test_name: Aspire launch profiles E2E debugs a Deno AppHost through the built-in JavaScript debugger
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, launch-profiles)
error_pattern: Timed out after 300000ms waiting for debug AppHost startup. ... debugSessions: [{ appHostPath: DenoAppHost/apphost.mts, startupCompleted: false }] ... AggregateError: Launch profiles E2E teardown failed. 1. Error: EBUSY: resource busy or locked, rmdir 'C:\Users\runneradmin\AppData\Local\Temp\aev-*\workspace\DenoAppHost'
analysis: The Deno AppHost debug session in the launch-profiles E2E shard never reports startupCompleted within the 5-minute timeout, and the resulting file lock on the workspace temp directory then causes the test's 'after each' teardown hook to fail with EBUSY on Windows. This matches the general pattern of flaky VS Code extension E2E shards (also seen with EBUSY rmdir failures in the dynamic-debug-configuration shard) and is unrelated to the PR, which only modifies Aspire.Dashboard and Aspire.Hosting console-log APIs, not the VS Code extension or Deno AppHost debugging.
